vendors.name: Dotykačka
vendors.reason: Czech POS. Its NEOMEZENĚ licence ('1 990 Kč' a month without terminal, bez DPH, 1 měsíc; 20 298 Kč a year) lists 'Objednávkové systémy', but its ordering-systems page shows these are third-party integrations (Foodora, Choice, Wolt, Bolt Food, Speedlo, Adaptee Gastro), 'paid services' with no price, and never mentions pickup. Not its own ordering product.
vendors.note: Price read from the cenik page's embedded price data (raw HTML): NEOMEZENĚ, '1 měsíc', 'Nemám zájem o terminál', price_without_vat '1 990 Kč'.

vendors.name: Speedlo
vendors.reason: Czech delivery-ordering system (named on Dotykačka's integrations page); https://www.speedlo.cz/cenik returned only the domain name - unreadable.

vendors.name: Storyous
vendors.reason: Czech POS; its pages in search mention connecting delivery and QR ordering channels and a kiosk, but no own pickup ordering product or Kč price. Not opened.

notes: CZ counts DISH and Menu55. Third: Vitrina (stored 2bfa2064, restaurant tool, mine) - its Czech site read today (found via the RO page's currency selector, which lists 'Česko Kč'): Start 'od 950 Kč měsíčně a nejvýš 0,9 %' (monthly-billed; 855/760 Kč on 6/12 months), Express 0 Kč + 3 %, 'Ceny bez DPH', pickup and orders for a set time, 'Comgate v Česku'. Only the first 100 000 characters were read. Not eligible: Dotykačka (its 'Objednávkové systémy' are third-party integrations, NEOMEZENĚ 1 990 Kč/month), Speedlo (unreadable), Storyous (no price). CZ = 3 if Vitrina is accepted. Note: Vitrina's selector also lists Hungary (Ft) and Poland (zł).
